name: Folio geometric isometric
description: The production Folio project-icon direction: flat, geometric, isometric, spare, and circle-safe.
promptTemplate:
Create one portfolio project icon.

Subject brief:
{{subject}}

Color palette:
Use only this selected palette target: {{colorPalette}}. Use its first color as the solid background.

Style contract:
Flat geometric isometric tile icon, not a scene. Strict simple isometric geometry: one dominant silhouette and at most two small supporting forms. One thin dark outline is allowed only where a complex form needs it. No texture, halftone, distressed or grungy treatment, lighting, cast shadows, gradients, gloss, bevels, photorealism, pseudo-text, labels, letters, logos, or colors outside the selected palette. The solid background is intended as a circular field. Keep every critical part within the central 70 percent of the canvas, circle-safe with a 15 percent margin. It must remain legible at 80, 96, and 112 pixels.
